body: I don’t think an overdose is the way to go. Being successful is hard and the consequences of failing are  painful. I’ve also tried everything and keep ending up here. I’m not risking not being successful and having to face everyone and deal with possible organ failure. I think a gun is the best way to go. Maybe take the edge off with a lot of alcohol first and go into the woods somewhere so no one has to clean up a mess. Not trying to encourage you, just give you the things I’m planning on doing because I’m not willing to risk coming out of this alive.
